## 📝 Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue or feature request is addressed.

## 🧪 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧹 Refactoring or code cleanup
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (`make lint`).
- [ ] I have formatted my code with `make format`.
- [ ] I have run pre-commit hooks (`make precommit`).
- [ ] I have added/updated tests if applicable (`make test`).
- [ ] All tests pass locally.
